findings.title: Israeli attacks kill 2 Palestinians, wound 5 in Gaza
findings.location: Jabalia refugee camp (northern Gaza); al-Mawasi near Rafah and Khan Younis (southern Gaza); Bureij refugee camp (central Gaza)
findings.affected_population_or_system: Palestinian residents including a fisherman and a child; two reported killed and five wounded in separate incidents
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Israeli attacks killed two Palestinians and wounded five others across the Gaza Strip on Tuesday
findings.source_type: Established newswire reporting attributed to medical and civil-defence sources

bounded_discovery_context.discovery: Targeted search 8 of 12 (Anadolu 28 October 2026), followed by direct inspection of the publisher article.
bounded_discovery_context.freshness_limit: Article is dated 28 October in the publisher's time zone but has no clock timestamp exposed. Incident date is Tuesday 27 October, outside this watch's observation interval; the evidence qualifies as newly surfaced reporting, not a verified in-window occurrence.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_screen: Prior heartbeat had no record of the two newly reported deaths (Mahmoud Samih al-Harsh in Jabalia and unidentified victim in al-Mawasi near Rafah), or the five wounded. The separately reported six-year-old girl's death is an established WAFA 27 October item and is not counted again.
bounded_discovery_context.attribution: The report cites local medical sources, an Al-Awda Hospital source and civil defence; independent first-hand verification is not available in this bounded watch.

findings.exact_supporting_passage: Ahmed Yassin Bseiso also died from injuries sustained days earlier in an Israeli strike on al-Thawra Street in central Gaza City.
